# routeros_tool_romon (Resource)
Settings of `/tool romon`. Per-interface settings (`/tool romon port`) are not covered. Deleting the resource only removes it from the state.

## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_tool_romon" "this" {
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable RoMON (Router Management Overlay Network).
- `romon_id` (String) RoMON ID of the router (`id` in RouterOS, a MAC address); `00:00:00:00:00:00` makes RouterOS use one of its interface MAC addresses.
- `secrets` (Set of String, Sensitive) Secrets used to authenticate RoMON packets; an empty set disables authentication.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
terraform import routeros_tool_romon.this .
```
